name: assetpanda/page-timeline
title: AP Page Timeline
description: Journey section of the 2026 company pages (Our Company, Figma 7385:186215): a sticky intro column (eyebrow, heading with a gradient phrase, lede) beside a timeline of milestones. Each milestone sits behind a left rule that deepens from indigo-200 to indigo-600 down the list and carries a year label, a heading, paragraphs, an optional small note and arrow links; an optional closing statement in gradient type ends the last milestone. This block is an adapter — it holds no markup; it maps attributes to kit props.
